mapper.sql: p.id, p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.cover, p.state, p.review_round, p.review_entered_at, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.expire_at
COALESCE(plc.like_count, 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(pcc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(pvc.view_count, 0) AS view_count
LEFT JOIN bs_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN post_like_count plc ON plc.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN post_comment_count pcc ON pcc.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN post_view_count pvc ON pvc.post_id = p.post_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (post_id, user_id, title, content, images, cover, state, review_round, review_entered_at, create_time, update_time, expire_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{cover}, #{state}, #{reviewRound}, #{reviewEnteredAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT post_id FROM post

SELECT , FROM post p
WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.state != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, images = #{images}, cover = #{cover}, update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE post SET state = 'PENDING_REVIEW', review_round = review_round + 1, review_entered_at = NOW(), expire_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE post SET state = 'DRAFT', update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
UPDATE post SET state = 'DRAFT', update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state = 'REJECTED'
mapper.select:
SELECT , FROM post p
WHERE p.post_id IN #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET state = 'DELETED', update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state != 'DELETED'
UPDATE post SET state = 'NORMAL', update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
UPDATE post SET state = 'REJECTED', update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
mapper.select:
SELECT , FROM post p
WHERE p.state = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY
COALESCE(plc.like_count, 0) DESC, p.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC p.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post WHERE state = 'NORMAL'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state IN ('NORMAL', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'DRAFT', 'REJECTED')

SELECT , FROM post_like pl JOIN post p ON pl.post_id = p.post_id
WHERE pl.user_id = #{userId} AND p.state IN ('NORMAL', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY pl.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_like pl JOIN post p ON pl.post_id = p.post_id WHERE pl.user_id = #{userId} AND p.state IN ('NORMAL', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'REJECTED')

SELECT , FROM (SELECT post_id, MAX(create_time) AS latest_at FROM post_comment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY post_id) my_comments JOIN post p ON my_comments.post_id = p.post_id
WHERE p.state IN ('NORMAL', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY my_comments.latest_at DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT post_id FROM post_comment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY post_id) my_comments JOIN post p ON my_comments.post_id = p.post_id WHERE p.state IN ('NORMAL', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'REJECTED')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'NORMAL'

SELECT , FROM post_like pl JOIN post p ON pl.post_id = p.post_id
WHERE pl.user_id = #{userId} AND p.state = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY pl.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_like pl JOIN post p ON pl.post_id = p.post_id WHERE pl.user_id = #{userId} AND p.state = 'NORMAL'
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO post_like (post_id, user_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{postId}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: INSERT INTO post_like_count (post_id, like_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{postId}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count + #{delta}), update_time = NOW()
UPDATE post_like_count SET like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count - #{delta}), update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO user_view_history (user_id, post_id, viewed_at) VALUES
(#{userId}, #{postId}, NOW())
mapper.update: INSERT INTO post_view_count (post_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{postId}, #{delta}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT , FROM user_view_history uvh JOIN post p ON uvh.post_id = p.post_id
WHERE uvh.user_id = #{userId} AND (p.state = 'NORMAL' OR (p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.state != 'DELETED')) ORDER BY uvh.viewed_at DESC, uvh.post_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_view_history uvh JOIN post p ON uvh.post_id = p.post_id WHERE uvh.user_id = #{userId} AND (p.state = 'NORMAL' OR (p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.state != 'DELETED'))
mapper.update: INSERT INTO post_feed_index (post_id, state, feed_time, like_count, update_time) VALUES (#{postId}, 'NORMAL', NOW(), 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = 'NORMAL', update_time = NOW()
UPDATE post_feed_index SET state = #{state}, update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE post_feed_index SET like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count + #{delta}), update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_feed_index (post_id, state, feed_time, like_count, update_time) SELECT p.post_id, p.state, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(cr.create_time) FROM content_review cr WHERE cr.target_type = 'POST' AND cr.target_id = p.post_id AND cr.action = 'APPROVE'), p.create_time), COALESCE(lc.like_count, 0), NOW() FROM post p LEFT JOIN post_like_count lc ON lc.post_id = p.post_id WHERE p.state = 'NORMAL' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_review cr2 WHERE cr2.target_type = 'POST' AND cr2.target_id = p.post_id AND cr2.action = 'APPROVE')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_view_count WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_view_history h WHERE h.post_id = post_view_count.post_id)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_view_count (post_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) SELECT h.post_id, COUNT(*), NOW(), NOW() FROM user_view_history h GROUP BY h.post_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count), update_time = NOW()
